## getPermitTypedData() function

Permit signature for ERC20 tokens, following EIP-2612. Fails closed when fetched EIP-5267 metadata is not bound to the token and chain. Consumers should use another approval path instead of signing an unsafe domain. Docs: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612

**Signature:**

```typescript
getPermitTypedData: (args: PermitArgs, chainId: ChainId) => TypedDataDefinition<typeof permitTypes, "Permit">
```

**Returns:**

TypedDataDefinition&lt;typeof permitTypes, "Permit"&gt;

Typed data ready to pass to a wallet for signing.

## Exceptions

InvalidPermitDomainChainIdError when fetched EIP-5267 metadata targets another chain or omits `chainId`<!-- -->.

InvalidPermitDomainVerifyingContractError when fetched EIP-5267 metadata targets another token or omits `verifyingContract`<!-- -->.

UnsupportedPermitDomainExtensionsError when fetched EIP-5267 metadata advertises extension fields unsupported by this helper.
